description.text: Near-total darkness fills the frame, broken only by a narrow horizontal band of pale light along the showroom floor.

sits at the edge of that darkness, its low nose angled toward the light. The carbon-fibre bodywork is mostly hidden in shadow; only the leading edge of the hood, the grille surround and a sliver of the front wheel catch the faint glow. The surface reads as deep black with a cold, resinous sheen, and the grille's horizontal slats emerge one by one as the vehicle inches forward. Reflections slide along the curved fender and across the polished floor, which is otherwise empty and smooth. The car's movement is slow and deliberate, a quiet creep rather than a lunge, while the surrounding space stays almost black. A low engine idle underpins the moment, paired with the faint, crisp sound of tyres easing over the floor. The composition keeps the car low in the frame, emphasizing the long nose and the gradual separation of bodywork from shadow. As the nose enters the light, the contrast sharpens: the illuminated edge glows, the recessed grille stays dark, and the floor reflects a thin, wavering streak beneath the bumper. The car continues forward at the same measured pace, preserving the restrained, suspenseful tone of the reveal.

rolls forward out of the shadow into a broad pool of light, its full front three-quarter form becoming clear. The black carbon-fibre body carries soft highlights along the hood, roof line and front fender, while the grille and lower intake remain deep, matte voids. The car advances across the smooth floor at a steady, deliberate pace, and its reflection stretches beneath it, breaking into softer shapes as the body moves. The surrounding showroom stays minimal and uncluttered: pale floor, dim walls, no other vehicles or people in view. Light falls in a clean wash from above and ahead, giving the bodywork a cool sheen without flattening the black paint. The engine note settles into a steady rumble, and the tyres make a low, continuous roll across the floor. As the car moves farther into the light, more of its side and rear haunch become visible, and the initial mystery of the dark opening gives way to a clear, composed reveal. The motion remains smooth and controlled, with no sudden acceleration; the car simply claims the open floor, its shape growing more legible against the pale surroundings.
